value-primary.$description: Primary input text color. Use for user-entered text and selected values inside form fields.

value-inverse.$description: Inverse input text. Use for text in dark-background or inverted input variants.

value-link.$description: Link value text in field. Use for clickable/linked values displayed in read-only fields.

value-placeholder.$description: Placeholder text color. Use for hint/placeholder text in empty form fields.

value-disabled.$description: Disabled input text color. Apply to text content inside disabled form fields.

icon.$description: Input icon color. Use for leading and trailing icons inside form fields.

bg-default.$description: Default input background. Base fill for text inputs, selects, textareas, and all form fields.

border-default.$description: Default input border. Default stroke for form field outlines in resting state.

bg-focus.$description: Focused input background tint. Subtle fill applied to input background when focused.

border-focus.$description: Focused input border. Apply to input border when the field has keyboard or pointer focus.

bg-danger.$description: Error state input background tint. Subtle fill applied to input background on validation error.

border-danger.$description: Error state input border. Apply when a field has a validation error.

bg-disabled.$description: Disabled input background. Apply to fields that are non-interactive.

brand.$description: Brand-colored body text. Use for hyperlinks, active navigation labels, and brand-emphasized inline copy.

primary.$description: Primary body text. Default for all headings, body copy, labels, and high-emphasis text content.

secondary.$description: Secondary/subdued text. Use for supporting copy, captions, timestamps, placeholders, and helper text.

tertiary.$description: Secondary/subdued text. Use for supporting copy, captions, timestamps, placeholders, and helper text.

inverse.$description: Inverted text for dark surfaces. Use on brand-filled, dark, or image backgrounds where primary text is illegible.

links.$description: Hyperlink text color. Apply to all clickable inline text links across the UI.

disabled.$description: Disabled text. Use for labels, values, and copy on disabled inputs, buttons, and non-interactive elements.

danger.$description: Danger/error text. Use for validation error messages, destructive action labels, and critical inline alerts.

warning.$description: Warning text. Use for cautionary inline messages, advisory labels, and warning callout copy.

success.$description: Success text. Use for positive feedback messages, confirmation labels, and completed-action copy.

brand.$description: Brand-colored border. Use for focused input outlines, selected item rings, and brand-accented dividers.

strong.$description: Strong/high-contrast border. Use for prominent dividers and high-emphasis UI boundaries.

medium.$description: Medium-emphasis border. Use for secondary dividers, table row separators, and mid-weight visual boundaries.

subtle.$description: Default/subtle border. Use for standard input strokes, card edges, and general-purpose section dividers.

transparent.$description: Transparent/invisible border. Use as a layout placeholder border to preserve spacing without visible stroke.

danger.$description: Danger/error border. Use for invalid input outlines and error-state borders.

warning.$description: Warning border. Use for cautionary input outlines and warning-state borders.

success.$description: Success border. Use for valid input outlines and success-state borders.

primary.$description: Primary icon color. Default for all standard UI icons in normal/active states.

secondary.$description: Secondary/subdued icon. Use for supporting icons, trailing chevrons, and decorative non-action icons.

soft.$description: Soft/muted icon color. Use for low-emphasis decorative icons and secondary supporting iconography.

inverse.$description: Inverted icon color. Use for icons placed on brand-filled, dark, or high-contrast surfaces.

brand.$description: Brand-colored icon. Use for primary action icons and brand-highlighted UI elements.

disabled.$description: Disabled icon color. Use for icons on disabled controls and non-interactive UI states.

danger.$description: Danger icon color. Use in error states, destructive action icons, and critical alert indicators.

warning.$description: Warning icon color. Use in cautionary states and advisory alert icons.

success.$description: Success icon color. Use in success states, completion checkmarks, and positive feedback icons.

bg.$description: Primary button default background. Default fill for all primary CTA buttons.

hover.$description: Primary button hover background. Apply on pointer hover over primary buttons.

pressed.$description: Primary button pressed/active background. Apply on pointer down over primary buttons.

text-neutral.$description: Primary button label color. Use for text and icon content inside primary buttons.

text-hard.$description: Primary button label color. Use for text and icon content inside primary buttons.

border.$description: Primary button border. Typically transparent — use to maintain consistent layout with bordered variants.

outlined.$description: Primary outlined button variant fill. Use for the outlined/ghost variant of the primary button.

bg.$description: Secondary button default background. Default fill for secondary action buttons.

border.$description: Secondary button border color. Use for outlined secondary button strokes.

bg.$description: Soft action button default background. Use for neutral secondary actions and subdued interactive elements.
Ghost button default background. Use for low-emphasis tertiary actions with minimal visual weight.
Success action button background. Use for confirm, complete, and approve action buttons.
Warning action button background. Use for caution actions that need user attention before proceeding.
Destructive action button background. Use for delete, remove, and irreversible action buttons.

bg-soft.$description: Destructive action button background. Use for delete, remove, and irreversible action buttons.

bg.$description: Disabled button/element background. Apply to all non-interactive and disabled action elements.

ring.$description: Focus ring color. Visible focus indicator ring around interactive elements. Required for accessibility — do not remove.

ring-offset.$description: Focus ring offset background. Color behind the gap between a focused element and its focus ring.

bg-default.$description: Soft action button default background. Use for neutral secondary actions and subdued interactive elements.

base.$description: Default page canvas background. Apply to the root-level surface behind all UI content. Do not use for elevated containers.

secondary.$description: Slightly elevated surface. Use for cards, sidebars, and panels one level above the base canvas.

tertiary.$description: Second-level elevated surface. Use for nested panels, table header rows, and layered card backgrounds.

brand.$description: Primary brand fill surface. Use for CTA button backgrounds, active nav highlights, and selected state fills.

brand-hover.$description: Brand surface hover state. Apply over surface/brand on pointer hover interactions.

brand-pressed.$description: Brand surface pressed/active state. Apply over surface/brand on pointer down or keyboard activation.

brand-bg.$description: Subtle brand tint background. Use for selected rows, active sidebar items, and brand-accented container backgrounds.

danger.$description: Danger/error solid background. Use for destructive action button fills and critical alert banners.

danger-subtle.$description: Subtle danger background tint. Use for inline error states, validation message backgrounds, and error callouts.

warning.$description: Warning solid background. Use for warning action buttons and high-visibility cautionary surfaces.

warning-subtle.$description: Subtle warning background tint. Use for inline warning states and cautionary callout backgrounds.

success.$description: Success solid background. Use for success action buttons and positive confirmation banner fills.

success-subtle.$description: Subtle success background tint. Use for inline success states and completed-action backgrounds.

disabled.$description: Disabled element background. Apply to all non-interactive or disabled UI surfaces and controls.

bg.$description: Tooltip container background. Dark fill for tooltip popovers. Always pair with tool-tip/text.

text.$description: Tooltip text color. Use for all text content inside tooltip components.

open.$description: Open/unfilled shift status color. Use for shift labels, badges, and dot indicators.

open-bg.$description: Open shift background tint. Pair with status/shift/open for badge and chip backgrounds.

need-review.$description: Needs-review shift status color. Use when a shift requires supervisor attention.

scheduled-bg-active.$description: Today's active scheduled shift background. Use for the current date highlight on shift calendars.

unpublished.$description: Unpublished shift status color. Use for draft shifts not yet visible to caregivers.

completed-bg.$description: Completed task background tint. Pair with status/task/completed for badge backgrounds.

primary-bg.$description: Primary sidebar background. Main fill for the primary navigation sidebar panel.

primary-foreground.$description: Primary sidebar foreground. Primary text color for content within the main sidebar.

secondary-bg.$description: Secondary sidebar panel background. Use for nested panels, sub-navigation, and secondary drawers.

secondary-foreground.$description: Secondary sidebar text and icons. Use for text and icon content in secondary sidebar panels.

accent-bg.$description: Sidebar accent/hover background. Use for hovered or highlighted nav item backgrounds.

accent-foreground.$description: Sidebar accent foreground. Use for text and icons in hovered or highlighted nav items.

border.$description: Sidebar border and dividers. Use for section dividers and boundaries within the sidebar.

ring.$description: Sidebar active indicator ring. Use for the selection ring around the active nav item.

text.$description: Sidebar default nav item text. Use for navigation labels in resting state.

text-active.$description: Sidebar active nav item text. Use for the label of the currently selected navigation item.

icon.$description: Sidebar default nav item icon. Use for navigation icons in resting state.

icon-active.$description: Sidebar active nav item icon. Use for the icon of the currently selected navigation item.

neutral.$description: Neutral tag foreground. Use for default, inactive, or general-purpose tag labels.

neutral-bg.$description: Neutral tag background. Pair with tags/neutral for default tag backgrounds.

disabled.$description: Disabled tag foreground. Use for non-interactive or inactive tag labels.

red.$description: Red tag foreground. Use for urgent, high-priority, or error-state tag labels and icons.

red-bg.$description: Red tag background. Pair with tags/red for urgent or error-state tag chip backgrounds.

yellow.$description: Yellow tag foreground. Use for warning or pending-state tag labels.

yellow-bg.$description: Yellow tag background. Pair with tags/yellow for warning or pending tag backgrounds.

green.$description: Green tag foreground. Use for success, active, or completed-state tag labels.

green-bg.$description: Green tag background. Pair with tags/green for success or active tag backgrounds.

blue.$description: Blue tag foreground. Use for informational or brand-related tag labels.

blue-bg.$description: Blue tag background. Pair with tags/blue for informational tag backgrounds.

purple.$description: Purple tag foreground. Use for special, featured, or premium tag labels.

purple-bg.$description: Purple tag background. Pair with tags/purple for special or featured tag backgrounds.

none.$description: No-elevation shadow color. Transparent — use for completely flat non-elevated surfaces.

xs.$description: Extra-small elevation shadow color. Use for subtle card lifts, dropdown containers, and minimal depth.

secondary-bg.$description: Popover secondary background. Use for nested content areas and secondary panels inside popovers.

secondary-foreground.$description: Popover secondary foreground. Use for text and icons in secondary areas of popover containers.

1.$description: First chart/data-viz series color. Use for the primary data series in charts, graphs, and visualizations.
